class.name: PerformanceSummary
class.brief_description: Statistics of a [PerformanceRecorder] run: per column and frame-time hitches.

method.name: get_column
method.description: Returns the statistics of the column [param name]. Prints an error and returns [code]null[/code] if the column was not recorded; use [method has_column] to check first.

method.name: get_column_names
method.description: Returns the names of the columns, in CSV order.

method.name: get_columns
method.description: Returns the statistics of all columns, in CSV order.

method.name: get_duration_usec
method.description: Returns the time from [method PerformanceRecorder.start] to [method PerformanceRecorder.stop] (or to now while recording), in microseconds.

method.name: get_frame_count
method.description: Returns the number of frames seen while recording, including the frames between two rows when [member PerformanceRecordingProfile.sample_interval_frames] is greater than [code]1[/code].

method.name: get_hitch_count
method.description: Returns the number of frames whose frame time was above [method get_hitch_threshold_usec].

method.name: get_hitch_frames
method.description: Returns the process frame numbers ([method Engine.get_process_frames]) of the hitches, oldest first. Only the first 1024 hitches are kept; [method get_hitch_count] keeps counting after that.

method.name: get_hitch_threshold_usec
method.description: Returns the hitch threshold of the recording, in microseconds ([member PerformanceRecordingProfile.hitch_threshold_usec]). [code]0[/code] means hitch detection was disabled.

method.name: get_recorded_frame_count
method.description: Returns the number of recorded rows, like [method PerformanceRecorder.get_recorded_frame_count].

method.name: has_column
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the column [param name] was recorded.

method.name: is_percentiles_exact
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the whole run fits in the ring buffer and all percentiles are exact. For longer runs the percentiles are estimated from a histogram (see [PerformanceColumnSummary]).

method.name: to_text
method.description: Returns the summary as JSON text, the same content that [member PerformanceRecordingProfile.write_summary_json] writes to [code]<output>.summary.json[/code]: [code]frame_count[/code], [code]recorded_frame_count[/code], [code]duration_usec[/code], [code]percentiles_exact[/code], [code]hitches[/code] ([code]threshold_usec[/code], [code]count[/code], [code]frames[/code]), [code]columns[/code] (per column [code]count[/code], [code]min[/code], [code]max[/code], [code]avg[/code], [code]p50[/code], [code]p95[/code], [code]p99[/code]) and, if the column [code]frame_time[/code] was recorded, [code]frame_time_histogram[/code] ([code]limits_usec[/code] for 240, 120, 60, 30, 20 and 10 FPS, and [code]counts[/code], see [method PerformanceColumnSummary.get_histogram]).
